title: Nutty Spicy Indian Tofu Kebabs
description: A spicy and crunchy plant-based Indian dish featuring vanilla pod and tandoor flavors, perfect for a romantic evening.

ingredients.name: extra firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into 1 inch cubes

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together tandoori masala, garam masala, cayenne pepper, and salt.
Add the tofu cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Thread the tofu cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each cube.
Brush the peanut oil onto the tofu cubes.
Sprinkle the chopped peanuts and cilantro onto the tofu cubes.
Scrape the seeds from the vanilla pod and sprinkle onto the tofu cubes.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 20 minutes.
Brush the lemon juice onto the tofu cubes and bake for an additional 5 minutes.
Serve the kebabs hot, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
